source_text: Ne societis gentibus quae remanserunt — laquei et offendicula. Ne invocetis deos earum. In nobis remanentia vitia non amica sint.
pass_a_gloss: Do-not ally with-nations which have-remained — snares and stumbling-blocks. Do-not invoke gods their. In us remaining vices not friends let-them-be.
pass_b_english: [[Do not mix with the nations that remain — snares and traps >> Bible:Joshua 23:7-13]]. Do not invoke their gods. Let remaining vices in us not become friends.
